svg.title: R5 node reference map for human review
svg.desc: A not-to-scale node-reference map showing permanent corner nodes, object outer-casing and footprint nodes, paired face nodes for the current demolishable Room C stud wall, and a compact vertical-reference convention. It annotates the human-observed 580 mm Room C relationship from the D3-CL turning corner to D2-CR but creates no derived shell geometry.
svg.text: NODE REFERENCE MAP — NOT TO SCALE
R5 active field reference • reference language only • no SVG distance, angle, proportion or drawn wall thickness is geometry
LEFT / RIGHT: stand in the named room or area and face the door, window or cupboard.
Object nodes mark the outermost visible casing/architrave or external footprint — never the clear opening, leaf, shelf or hidden construction.

g.text: Detailed panels define the proposed node language.
No comprehensive measurement paths are shown.
Wall-plane readings need no predeclared map reference.
Visible sequence: A5 → W1-AL → W1-AR → A6

svg.text: Cupboard/W2 nodes remain provisional; D3-CL turn and 580 mm to D2-CR are human-observed.

g.text: wall turns at D3-CL; continues upward
D3-CL → D2-CR · observed 580 mm · not to scale
current bedroom stud wall · thickness shown
outer: open Room C side · inner: current bedroom side

svg.text: Family A: B0-B4 // return · Family B: D3 // B0.5-B1 // T0-T1 // opposite walls · D5 gap has no wall
Wall-plane readings may be described directly later;
they do not need predeclared face references.
Paired points distinguish the two measurable stud-wall faces.
A / B / C / WC — viewing room or area
Later vertical: UOC ↔ CLG for each measured face.
W#-SILL / W#-FFL — sill and floor below
CP1-BASE / CP1-FFL — lower casing/base and floor
These are elevation datums, not plan-position nodes.
Exact ceiling/floor station must be recorded in the field.
ACTIVE R5 FIELD REFERENCE — CURRENT STUD WALL CORRECTED — NO DRAWN DISTANCE, ANGLE, PROPORTION OR THICKNESS IS A MEASUREMENT.
